title: Trash day
plot: Yuki teaches Alex trash day; Kenta's trash is all coffee.
paragraphs: In the morning, Yuki came by.
ユキ|「アレックス、今日はゴミの日だよ。」

paragraphs.note: Trash in Japan is sorted, and each kind goes out on its own morning: burnable, plastic, cans and bottles. Miss the day and it waits a week.

paragraphs: アレックス|「これも今日？」
アレックス|「ケンタのゴミは？」
ユキ|「コーヒーのゴミだよ。」
